faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Chhattisgarh High Court for filling up Legal Assistant positions in Bilaspur through offline applications.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies have been announced for the Legal Assistant post under advertisement number 05/Legal Assistant/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed offline application form is 31-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Legal Assistant?
faq.answer: Applicants must be Fresh Law Graduates from a recognized university to be eligible for the Chhattisgarh High Court Legal Assistant position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 to 30 years of age as on 01.01.2026 to apply for the Chhattisgarh High Court Legal Assistant recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or monthly honorarium offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 30,000/- per month during their contractual period of engagement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type and duration of engagement?
faq.answer: The position is contractual for an initial period of one year, which is extendable up to a maximum period of three years.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website of the High Court of Chhattisgarh at https://highcourt.cg.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Legal Assistant positions will be posted in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, at the High Court premises.
